name: Quote Helper
description: Turn selected message text into a review prompt, or open a ticket in the preview.

actions.title: Open quote pad
actions.description: Write a note beside a thread and insert it into that thread's composer.

actions.title: Review selected text
actions.description: Quote the selection in the composer and ask for a review.

actions.title: Open selected ticket
actions.description: Open a selected ticket identifier using your ticket URL template.

settings.label: Ticket URL template
settings.description: An HTTPS URL containing {ticket}, for example https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/issues/{ticket}.
